description: This file defines interfaces and implementations for managing Kubernetes Ingress resources, including methods for creating, updating, deleting, listing, watching, and applying ingress objects within a specific namespace.

classes.name: ingresses
classes.description: Implementation of the IngressInterface for managing ingress resources.

methods.name: UpdateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of an ingress.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes an ingress resource by name.

methods.name: DeleteCollection
methods.description: Deletes a collection of ingress resources.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves an ingress resource by name.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists ingress resources based on list options.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches for changes to ingress resources.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to an ingress resource.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to an ingress resource.

methods.name: ApplyStatus
methods.description: Applies a declarative configuration to the status subresource of an ingress.

methods.name: newIngresses
methods.description: Constructs a new ingress client for a specific namespace.
